telegram_login_info:
🔐 Why does tAIger app need your Telegram authorization?

In the tAIger app, you can enable automatic post improvement — just drop raw notes into the draft channel, and tAIger will:

✨ Process them according to your instructions
📢 Publish them in the clean channel on your behalf
⏳ With the right interval — without extra actions

⚠️ Important:
Bots cannot do this — Telegram prohibits them from accessing publishing and post scheduling.
Only an authorized account can use these functions.

✅ Need automation? Go through authorization and get a powerful content tool. You can revoke authorization at any time in the Telegram app security settings.
🚫 Don't need it? Just close the app — and continue using the bot as before.

q1.question: Is it safe to connect my channels?
q1.answer: Yes, we use official Telegram API and don't store your passwords. All data is encrypted.

q2.question: Can I cancel automatic publication?
q2.answer: Of course! You can always preview and edit posts before publication or set up delays.

q3.question: Does it work for channels on any topic?
q3.answer: Yes, our AI adapts to any niche: from cooking to IT, from beauty to business.

q4.question: What if I don't like the result?
q4.answer: Within the bonus starting balance you can tailor the processing of your posts: adjust the AI model and refine the rule. Give it a little time—and you'll definitely love the outcome!

q5.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
q5.answer: No! Setup takes 5 minutes. Just connect channels and start writing notes.
